title: Consolidated customer regulatory ask onramp and variance resolver
creator: Sana Patel
description: Design and implement a single onramp and automated variance resolver for incoming enterprise security and compliance requests (SOC2/ISO attestation questions, HIPAA mapping asks, GDPR/DPA data residency clauses, and long vendor questionnaires). The feature will classify incoming requests, compute a risk/effort score, surface required evidence, and route to the correct responder lane (Self-serve docs, Concierge, Legal/Product, or Engineering), with SLA targets per lane.
background: We currently handle enterprise security asks via ad hoc email + Zendesk workflows and rely heavily on Solutions Engineering for routing. This causes long MTTR for high-value customers and inconsistent SLAs. Recent enterprise deals stalled due to delayed DPA clarifications and missing SOC2 artifact bundles. Market differentiation requires faster, predictable responses and better evidence-bundling automation.
proposed_solution: Build an intake microservice + web form and API that normalizes incoming asks into a canonical 'compliance signal' object. Implement a rule-based + ML scoring pipeline: (1) taxonomy classification (attestation, contractual clause, data residency, technical control), (2) risk_score calculation (0-100) combining customer tier, data sensitivity, and required artifact complexity, (3) route decision using an SLA matrix. Provide a resolver that suggests annotated evidence (Confluence snippets, audit logs, S3 export links) and a one-click P1 escalation path to Concierge for high-risk tickets.
acceptance_criteria: New intake form accepts file uploads and converts questionnaire PDFs to text with >85% parsing accuracy
Automated classifier maps asks into one of: attestation, contractual, operational, data-residency, or vendor-questionnaire with >90% precision on our seed set
Routing matrix delivers tickets into lanes with defined SLAs: self-serve (48h), concierge (8h), legal review (3 business days), engineering (SLA TBD)
Evidence suggester returns at least 2 candidate artifacts for 80% of mapped questions
Dashboard shows per-customer MTTR and backlog by lane; sample dashboard visible to GTM and Security
API contract published and integration test passing on staging
metrics: % of tickets auto-routed correctly (human override rate)
Average time Legal spends per ticket
Conversion uplift for enterprise leads after onboarding the flow
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal alpha (Concierge + Solutions Eng) for top 10 customers; Phase 2: invite-only beta for enterprise customers with Concierge support; Phase 3: general availability with self-serve docs and API. Each phase includes runbook updates, playbook training for Concierge, and monthly review with Legal/Privacy.
dependencies: ENG-40590 (evidence search index for Confluence & S3)
risks: Classifier misrouting could expose sensitive requests to incorrect lanes
Parsing failures for noisy scanned PDFs increase manual work
Legal bandwidth could become a bottleneck without clear prioritization
False confidence from auto-suggested evidence may cause inaccurate responses
mitigations: Add explicit human-in-the-loop approval for any ticket with risk_score > 70
Fallback: when parsing confidence < 0.6, mark as 'requires manual review' and notify Solutions Eng
Reserve weekly Legal office hours for high-priority escalations
Include 'confidence' metadata on suggested artifacts and require a reviewer sign-off before sending to customers
